name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

company_profile.summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd is India's largest non-banking financial company (NBFC) and retail asset financier. Pioneering point-of-sale no-cost consumer durable financing, the company has diversified into personal loans, SME lending, mortgages through Bajaj Housing Finance, commercial credit, and digital payment infrastructure.

revenue_breakup.desc: Consumer durables, lifestyle financing, digital product EMI, and two/three-wheeler finance.
Salaried home loans, loan against property (LAP), and developer lease rental discounting.
Secured and unsecured working capital loans for small business owners and professionals.
Rural consumer durable financing, gold loans, and tractor/motorcycle retail lending.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% operational footprint across urban, semi-urban, and rural branches
moats_and_strengths: Customer franchise exceeding 88 million clients with unmatched proprietary credit risk algorithms.
Distribution reach spanning 4,000+ branch locations and over 1,50,000 point-of-sale retail merchant partners.
Massive cross-sell engine where over 60% of new loans are disbursed to existing credit-tested customers.
Superior return profile with Return on Assets (ROA > 4.2%) and Return on Equity (ROE ~ 22%).
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Assets Under Management (AUM): ₹3,50,000 Cr+ across 88M+ customer franchise

bullish_triggers: Listing of subsidiary Bajaj Housing Finance Ltd providing substantial balance sheet strength.
Omnichannel digital app ecosystem driving digital cross-sell and lowering customer acquisition costs (CAC).
New business verticals ramp-up (auto loans, credit cards, microfinance, and wealth management).
bearish_risks: Regulatory tightening by RBI regarding risk weights on unsecured retail loans.
Margin compression from higher cost of funds in domestic debt capital markets.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
